items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Then the band consisted of ... James E. Phillip played drums.

ctx.x: Then the band consisted of Jimmy Adyazin on the bass. Carnish, Willie Carnish was on trombone. Frank, I forget Frank's last name, played clarinet. The guy from across the lake? And then Brock played guitar. James E. Phillip played drums. That's way back now you don't talk about.
James E. Phillip? James E. Phillip.
